title: 地盤工学
subtitle: Geotechnical Engineering
keywords: Earth pqressure theory of Rankine and Coulomb 2.Earth pressure at rest 3.Earth pressure during earthquake 4.limit equilibrium method for slope stability 5.Modified Fullenius’ method
educationalGoal: This course is application of Soil Mechanics I and II, focuses on Lateral Earth Pressure and Slope Stability. Complete solutions are not exist for earth pressure and slope stability until now, then we have to combine theoretical and empirical method. Students are expected to choose solution method and soil parameters appropriately, and calculate the stability design.
advice: 1.Earth pressure Active and passive earth pressure Rankin's method Coulomb's method static earth pressure Earth pressure during earthquake Earth retaining wall 2.Stability of slope Limit equilibrium method of slope stability Modified Fellenius' method and Bishop's method for circular slip surface Jambu's method for non circular slip surface Natural slope failure and structure
books: Soil Mechanics Edition, by Yasufuku, Riko-Tosho
requiredKnowledge: Aquisition of Soilmechanics I and II. Enough skill of Physics (especially Mechanics of elastic body)

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand applicable condition and calculation method of Rankin and Coulomb's earth pressure.
Be able to calculate stability analysis of earth retaining wall.
Be able to understand basic knowledge of slope stability analysis and slice method.
Be able to understand mechanism of slope failure and estimate stability of slope with appropriate parameters.
